blocks.text: Credibility assess karna (maloomat ki saakh parakhna) ka matlab hai yeh maloom karna ke maloomat kisi expert (mahir) ya us mauzoo par authority (ikhtiyar) rakhne wale se aa rahi hai ya nahi.
Misal: Pakistan mein Eid ke chand nazar aane ki maloomat official Hilal Committee (Ruet-e-Hilal Committee) se aani chahiye, social media ke unverified (ghair tasdeeq shuda) sources se nahi.

blocks.prompt: Sehat ke mashware ke liye qabil-e-aitbaar source kaun hai?
blocks.explanation: Qualified doctor ya sehat ka official idara, kyunke unhein is mauzoo par ilm aur ikhtiyar hai; social media ki gumnaam post nahi.

items: Credibility: kya source mahir ya ikhtiyar wala hai? Eid ka chand: official Hilal Committee, social media nahi.
